Beautiful 3-Bedroom Ranch with Pool, Hot Tub & Spacious Great Room

Enjoy the best of both worlds—a village location with the peaceful atmosphere and privacy of a country setting. Tucked away on a quiet dead-end street in the Village of Fredonia, this 3-bedroom ranch offers comfortable one-level living, generous spaces, and a tranquil, country-like feel.

New roof. New pool. Central air. Covered porch. Epic deck.

Hardwood floors flow through much of the home, complemented by two full bathrooms, a spacious great room, and a convenient, attached one-car garage. The formal living room welcomes relaxing and entertaining, while the eat-in kitchen shines with oak cabinetry, solid-surface countertops, and abundant storage and workspace.

A comfortable primary bedroom features its own ensuite with a full bathroom. Two bedrooms feature hardwood floors. 

The heart of the home is the large great room, where a warm wood-burning Fieldstone fireplace creates an inviting gathering place for family and friends. A separate furnace in the crawl space provides zone heating.

Outside, discover a private backyard retreat designed for summer fun and year-round relaxation. Follow the elevated bridge to the 24' x 19' deck and new above-ground pool. Just off the covered porch, a hot tub offers a relaxing escape in every season.

Additional features include central air, a newer front porch, newer concrete driveway, newly painted aluminum siding. See attachment for additional updates.

This move-in-ready home blends comfort, convenience, and outdoor enjoyment in a quiet village setting.
